encodings: *B64 = RFC 4648 §4 standard base64 WITH "=" padding (tweetnacl-util); *Hex = lowercase hex; *Json / wire = exact UTF-8 string as emitted by JSON.stringify; rng.draws = PRNG draws in call order (see README.md#prng)
notes: Test-only deterministic randomness; NOT used by production. stream(label) = SHA-256(D||be32(0)) || SHA-256(D||be32(1)) || ... with D = UTF-8("mrenzo-golden-prng-v1|" + label).
Each randombytes(x, n) call consumes the next n bytes; draws are NOT re-aligned to 32-byte blocks.

tweetnacl calls randombytes for: nacl.randomBytes(n) → n; nacl.box.keyPair() → 32 (raw X25519 secret, unclamped); nacl.sign.keyPair() → 32 (Ed25519 seed). Ed25519 signing and box/secretbox are deterministic.
